description: Source code for Widevine storage management, including file I/O, cache handling, and checksum verification within the Widevine DRM system.

classes.name: WidevineStorage
classes.description: Manages persistent storage of Widevine DRM data, including reading, writing, listing, and checksum verification.

methods.description: Reads file content into a byte vector.

methods.name: WriteString
methods.description: Serializes a string into a byte vector.
